messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and fallback loops observed for /v1/chat in us-west-1 beginning ~02:02:00 UTC
Sam: I see it on SLO dash — error rate up to ~15% across the region. Latency normal but retries/fallbacks climbing. Paging oncall.
ops-pager: page sent to oncall-sre group  escalation -> Maria (primary)
Maria: oncall here. what's the suspected vector? routing or model?
Kevin: pulling KV and router logs. Early indicator: cached keys in kv-usw1 shards 21-23 are labeled with variant tag "stable-4b" while the selector should be routing to "stable-3b" for the current rollout. Looks like prefix builder produced keys missing the region token for some variants, so cross-variant cache hits occur.
Sam: that would explain wrong model being reused. Are requests then falling back across regions?
Kevin: yes. Local misses cause fallback -> us-east-1 endpoint. But us-east has cached keys for stable-4b, so fallback triggers another mismatch and sometimes triggers another cross-region call. A small percent gets into a fallback-repeat path.
Jordan: customer impact: interactive completions failing for ~310k requests in 12m. Three paying customers show high error spikes: finlytics, acme-corp, and formsly. Finlytics saw most failures.
Liz: product/CS: I'll prep outreach for the affected accounts; need ETA for mitigation.
Maria: mitigation options: 1) disable cross-region fallback for us-west-1 routers, 2) evict offending kv prefixes from shards 21-23, 3) temporarily pin routing to stable-3b for the region. Which is lowest risk?
Sam: prefer guard first: configure routers to treat variant-mismatch cache hits as misses (prevent fallback on mismatch) so we stop the loop. Then targeted eviction for the 3 shards.
Kevin: can flip flag `routing.prevent_variant_mismatch_fallback=true` and roll routers in us-west-1. rollout ~60-120s. Eviction: use safer tool: `redwood kv-tool evict --shard 21,22,23 --pattern "kv:us-west-1:*:variant:stable-*" --dry-run` then remove dry-run.
Maria: do that. Sam, coordinate router flip. Kevin, run dry-run then evict. Liz, start customer comms draft. Jordan, collect impact numbers for the incident page.
deploy-bot: route-config plan submitted by Sam at 02:05:17 UTC
Sam: applying guard now to router pool us-west-1-rt-1..3
incident-bot: route-config applied by Sam at 02:05:45 UTC  diff: +routing.prevent_variant_mismatch_fallback=true
Kevin: running dry-run eviction output:
```
redwood kv-tool evict --shard 21,22,23 --pattern "kv:us-west-1:*:variant:stable-*" --dry-run
# matched 632 keys on shard21, 590 on shard22, 605 on shard23
```
Kevin: eviction (non-dry) executed now with shard whitelisting.
Kevin: shard 22 had a permission timeout; retried and succeeded. All matched keys removed.
Maria: routers rolled, guard active. Error rate falling from 15% -> 4% over 3m. Cross-region fallback attempts down 92%.
Jordan: trace sampling shows correct variant stable-3b served locally for post-mit requests. Latency stable.
Liz: CS outreach drafted and approved; sending to Finlytics and Formsly now. Message explains transient routing mismatch and that we flushed incorrect cache keys and put a temporary guard to prevent reoccurrence; offer follow-up call.
Sam: also deploying temporary routing pin to avoid variant recalculation for 30m: `routing.variant_pin_ttl=1800` to reduce churn while we investigate.
deploy-bot: route-config update applied by Sam at 02:09:12 UTC
oncall-bot: handoff note: Sam -> Maria at 02:10 UTC. Sam standing by for customer escalation.
Maria: monitoring interval set to 30m, increase fallback decision logs for 1h.
Kevin: post-incident action items (prelim): [1] audit recent PRs touching prefix builder (suspect PR 2026-02-11 changed hyphen handling), [2] add unit+integration tests for prefix generation across region/variant combos, [3] harden kv-tool with dry-run defaults and shard whitelisting, [4] add an alert to detect >3 cross-region fallbacks per request within 10s.
Jordan: impact summary for the incident doc: ~310k requests affected, peak error 15%, 3 major customers impacted, mitigations deployed 4m after detection.
Liz: scheduling customer follow-up sync at 03:00 UTC.
Sam: creating incident page and attaching logs/traces. link: https://internal.redwood/insights/incident/1846237890
Kevin: discovered prefix-builder bug: when variant contains underscore or hyphen and region token is empty in builder, the region part was omitted resulting in ambiguous keys. adding a defensive null->"region" tag.
Maria: mitigation stable. leaving thread open for 45m to ensure no recurrence. ops-pager: page acknowledged -> mitigated at 02:11:30 UTC
incident-bot: last automated check at 02:13:10 UTC
Sam: thanks everyone. will open follow-up PRs and assign owners.
Liz: nice work :thumbsup:. keep updates in the incident doc.
Maria: locking thread for write-only updates after 45m if no further alerts.
Maria: note for postmortem: correlate deploy timestamps with prefix regression windows and add rollout guard to prevent prefix format changes without full backward compatibility tests.
